Break schedule & advanced staffing notesAutomatic breaks, light-load rules, and reassignment guidance
Show
Break ScheduleBreaks follow assignment order in two alternating groups. The first group matches the star-marked group on the facility whiteboard.
Assignment order
Each CNA row is an assignment/run number. CNA names are optional. Saved routines can predict who normally takes that assignment. Care Load points are advisory; the normal light-load limit is 2 assignments per shift. Choosing more requires a supervisor override confirmation because the remaining residents still have to be distributed fairly. A lighter assignment is calculated as part of the fair workload target from the start. “1 fewer” means one resident below the normal rounded-up target for that shift; it does not stack with the Workload Advisory button. For a call-off, Ordered Reassignment keeps the departing residents in strict room/bed order and gives consecutive blocks to the remaining Assignment numbers.

Interface modeSimple View shows one work area at a time. Full View keeps the richer all-at-once workspace for experienced users.

Automatic shift preparationAutomatic targeting is only a convenience for opening the likely current/upcoming shift. It never limits when DSD can prepare an assignment. Use Manual override or DSD Shift Planner for any date and any shift, including tomorrow or days/weeks ahead.
Current targetingCurrent shift

Separate prediction system: nurse/cart history never changes CNA resident counts, care-load calculations, or room balancing.

Workspace access

Owner/Admin manages the system. DSD / Scheduler can create daily assignments and monthly CNA schedules. Supervisor (LVN/RN desk nurse) can create daily assignments only. Viewers can review and print. Staff / Alerts accounts see only their own current finalized assignment and notification preference.

Add an account directly

Use this when you want to create an account yourself. For regular staff, the one-time invite flow below is usually easier.

Only needed for a truly new account. Existing accounts keep their password. Share a new password privately. Staff will choose their own personal 4–8 digit quick-login PIN after the first sign-in.

Generate Staff / Alerts invite

Create a one-time 6-digit invite code. The QR contains only the Catered Cottage Healthcare website address—the secret code is entered separately.

Email Assignment Alerts

Optional. When a finalized assignment includes a Staff / Alerts account by name, Catered Cottage Healthcare schedules an email 10 minutes before that shift. If finalization happens inside the last 10 minutes, the alert is queued immediately. Room/resident details are never placed in the email.

Email provider not configured

Email/password authentication and staff accounts work without this provider. A configured email provider is required for assignment-alert emails, automatic emailed PIN-recovery codes, and secure in-app feedback delivery.
Feedback & Bug Report Delivery

Owner/Admin only. The destination email is stored in protected cloud configuration and is not shown on the normal feedback form. Change it here if the support contact changes.

Automatic cloud save is always on after the initial copy is resolved. Local saving remains available as a fast fallback, and conflict protection still pauses rather than silently overwriting a newer cloud copy.
Privacy: Keep resident names, diagnoses, medications, medical record numbers and other private health information out of this app. Cloud Sync does not make the app a HIPAA-compliant clinical record system.
Access & Device SecurityCloud account 2FA, optional device PIN, and shared-device auto-lock.2FA
⌄
Authenticator App Two-Factor AuthenticationFree TOTP security through Supabase Auth. Owner/Admin accounts must verify a 6-digit authenticator code. DSD / Scheduler, Supervisor, Viewer, and Staff / Alerts accounts may enable it voluntarily; once enabled, their future cloud sign-ins also require the authenticator.
Checking role…Checking 2FA…
Recommended recovery setup: Supabase TOTP does not provide recovery codes. After enabling 2FA, add a second backup authenticator factor on another trusted device/app. Never share the QR code or setup secret.
Catered Cottage Healthcare Device LockYour approved cloud account is the main authorization layer. Owner/Admin requires authenticator-app 2FA; all other roles may enable it voluntarily. The optional 4–8 digit device PIN is only a faster device-level lock/re-auth for a shared workstation.
Device PIN lock is off
How security works: cloud email/password + workspace membership control account access; Owner/Admin requires 2FA. DSD / Scheduler, Supervisor, Viewer, and Staff / Alerts may enable 2FA voluntarily. The device PIN remains optional and device-specific, does not replace the password or 2FA, and does not encrypt browser storage. On shared computers, also use Lock or Sign Out and the computer’s own account/password protection.
Data, Backup & MaintenanceBackups and actions that change or clear saved workspace data.

Data, backup & recoveryBack up room status, CNA directory/routines, imported staff schedules, imported old-assignment history, assignment history, audit history, display preferences, and non-secret settings. The Device PIN itself is never exported.
Backups stay on the device unless you save/copy the exported file elsewhere.
Help, Suggestions & Bug ReportsSend app feedback securely without showing the private destination email.

Version History

v4.22.59 · Day Shift Nursing Support Flow
  • Reorganized the Staff nursing workflow around the facility's usual Day · 7 AM–3 PM pattern.
  • Medication Cart 1–3, Treatment, and Float/Other remain in the normal nursing staffing area for any shift.
  • MDS, MDS Assistant, IP Nurse, ADON, Supervisor, Desk, and Floor Orientation now appear under a clearly labeled Day Shift Support · 7 AM–3 PM section.
  • The Day Shift Support sections open automatically on Day shift and stay collapsed on Evening/Night to reduce clutter; DSD can still open and use them manually on another shift when needed.
  • Facility Internal sign-in behavior is preserved: staff entered in these roles flow to the internal sign-in sheet with the selected shift's actual times. September schedules, Observation logic, calendar improvements, and Official CDPH 530 behavior are unchanged.
v4.22.57 · Nursing Names on Facility Sign-In
  • Fixed the Facility Internal Nursing Staff Assignment and Sign-In Sheet so nurse names are pulled from the saved Nursing Monthly Schedule when no daily nursing assignment slots have been loaded yet.
  • Daily/manual nursing assignments remain authoritative once entered, so call-offs and replacements are not overwritten by the monthly schedule.
  • Existing editable drafts that contained no nurse rows receive the missing scheduled nurses once after upgrade. A finalized older revision is never changed silently; if it contains zero nurses while the monthly schedule has nurses, CareOps opens a corrected new draft revision and preserves the locked original in History.
  • Preserved the one-page Facility Internal print layout, larger centered text, CNA/Observation logic, calendar readability improvements, Yuli Miranda as LVN / IP Nurse, and the original Official CDPH 530 workflow.
v4.22.56 · One-Page Sign-In & At-a-Glance Calendars
  • Kept the Facility Internal sign-in sheet on one landscape Letter page in normal staffing use by reducing unnecessary blank rows, tightening print-only vertical spacing, and keeping the Internal Use Only footer attached to the same page without shrinking the important staff text.
  • Redesigned the CNA Monthly Schedule Calendar for faster reading: stronger date numbers/day labels, sticky date/name guidance, alternating row/column tracking, five-day and weekly visual dividers, a bottom date guide, and tap/click row highlighting so staff can trace their own schedule immediately.
  • Improved the Nursing Monthly Schedule with the same at-a-glance date guidance, wider full-screen calendar workspace, clearer W/OFF/RO cells, weekend/date separators, and row highlighting.
  • Improved both printed monthly calendars so staff can locate a date such as the 17th directly from bold top and bottom date guides instead of counting columns.
  • Preserved September CNA/nursing data, Observation pairing, Yuli Miranda as LVN / IP Nurse, the larger centered sign-in sheet fields, DSD workflows, and the original Official CDPH 530 workflow.
v4.22.55 · Regression Sweep & IP Nurse Sign-In Fix
  • Fixed the Facility Internal Nursing Staff Assignment and Sign-In Sheet roster builder so IP Nurse assignments—including Yuli Miranda—are included with Charge/Desk, Med Cart 1–3, Treatment, and Float/Other nurses.
  • Updated nursing and photographed-assignment import guidance to recognize ip_nurse consistently, including common IP/infection-prevention aliases.
  • Corrected stale six-role wording now that the nursing system supports seven role slots.
  • Regression-tested Observation coverage with active Observation beds and confirmed the existing census-driven OBS preload, floor-count reduction, and paired relief/break logic still work; Observation logic was intentionally left unchanged.
  • Preserved the larger centered Facility Internal sheet, Yuli Miranda as LVN / IP Nurse, September schedule data, CNA/nursing separation, assignment history, and the original Official CDPH 530 workflow.

  • Set Yuli Miranda as the usual IP Nurse while preserving her existing LVN credential.
  • Added an upgrade migration that removes the temporary Yuliana alias and remaps saved current nursing assignments, finalized nursing history, and nursing import references to Yuli Miranda.
  • Preserved the larger centered Facility Internal sign-in sheet introduced in v4.22.53 and left the original Official CDPH 530 workflow unchanged.
v4.22.53 · Larger Facility Sign-In & IP Nurse Role
  • Made the Facility Internal Nursing Staff Assignment and Sign-In Sheet substantially easier to read with larger table text, taller rows, stronger staff-name/assignment emphasis, and centered assignment, employee, discipline, and time values.

v4.22.52 · Nursing Directory Role Guard
  • Prevents ambiguous CNA-only names from being auto-created in the Nursing Directory while still allowing explicitly credentialed RN, LVN, or LPT staff.

  • Preserves the v4.22.51 DSD/runtime recovery, CNA schedules, Observation pairing, authentication/cloud behavior, Facility Internal sheet, and untouched Official CDPH 530 workflow.
v4.22.51 · Runtime & DSD Workflow Recovery
  • Fixed the startup runtime exception caused by bundled nursing-data seeding calling a helper outside its JavaScript scope. This was the root cause of Prepared Shift remaining on Checking… and later DSD controls failing to initialize.
  • Verified Prepared Shift now resolves to a real staffing state, DSD Shift Planner opens all three shifts, and Open Facility Sheet launches the DSD Staffing / Sign-In Sheet again.
  • Improved the Nursing Directory on iPhone: the modal now keeps its header and Done footer available while the staff list scrolls internally, and the app Generate / Review / Print bar is hidden behind open dialogs.
  • Standardized current user-facing branding to Catered Cottage Healthcare while preserving saved data, September schedules, duplicate-name protection, OBS pairing, and Official CDPH 530 behavior.

v4.22.47 · Photo Import Name Deduplication
  • Added stronger duplicate-name protection for CNA and nursing schedule imports created from photos/scans.
  • Name matching now ignores capitalization, punctuation, extra spaces, and accent marks, so examples such as Mely Cancino and Mely, Cancino resolve to one staff profile instead of creating duplicates.

  • Likely duplicate names inside the same CNA or nursing import file are rejected for review instead of silently creating two people.
  • Existing exact duplicate CNA/Nursing directory entries are consolidated safely at startup/import time; CNA schedule/profile references are remapped to the retained profile.

  • Official 530 generation now always overlays staffing data onto the preserved official page artwork; direct AcroForm editing is no longer used.
  • Changed the built-in template cache key so devices do not reuse the older encrypted cached PDF.
  • Facility Staffing Sheet preview no longer auto-launches the print dialog when its preview opens; the user remains on the preview and taps Print explicitly.
  • Assignment generation, OBS relief pairing, finalized history, cloud sync, and staffing calculations are unchanged.
v4.22.39 · iPhone Official 530 Static-Page Fallback
  • Fixed the remaining iPhone/Safari PDF-lib failure that could show “Expected instance … undefined” after direct-field generation failed.
  • Official 530 fallback pages are now embedded as static PDF pages before Catered Cottage Healthcare overlays staffing data, avoiding broken AcroForm/widget references from copied fillable pages.
  • Successful direct-filled pages are also serialized and re-embedded before they are added to the final PDF, improving cross-browser reliability.
  • Original instruction pages use the same static embedding path; the original CDPH artwork remains underneath the generated staffing data.
v4.22.38 · OBS Relief Break Guard
  • OBS break is always the opposite slot from its paired floor assignment so that floor CNA is available to relieve the OBS CNA.
  • Removed guessed OBS break times when a real floor pairing is not yet available.
  • Example: Assignment 7 breaks 7:00 PM; paired OBS breaks 7:30 PM; Assignment 7 covers OBS at 7:30 PM.
v4.22.37 · iPhone Official 530 PDF Reliability Fix
  • Fixed the Official CDPH 530 fillable-form font embedding path that could fail on iPhone/Safari with a cryptic PDF-lib “Expected instance … undefined” error.
  • Field appearance generation now uses a properly embedded Helvetica font before flattening.
  • If direct fillable-field completion fails for a particular official PDF, Catered Cottage Healthcare automatically falls back to overlaying the staffing data on the original official page instead of stopping generation.
  • The generated PDF remains available in the same Official 530 screen for Preview, Open, Share / Save, or Download.
  • Preserved OBS relief pairing, exception-only Assignment Status, original handwritten signature spaces, and all v4.22.36 staffing logic.
v4.22.36 · OBS Relief Pairing, Exception-Only Status & Reliable 530 Preview
  • Paired each Observation room with the nearest regular floor assignment by room/bed location; the Observation CNA now receives the opposite break slot so the paired floor CNA can relieve the sitter.
  • Carried the same Observation relief break into Review and the generated Facility/Official 530 meal-break times.
  • Condensed Assignment Status to show only warnings/errors, with one compact Ready message when all checks pass; normal Shower, Break, Observation, Hospital, and Nursing details are collapsed under Shift details.
  • Reworked Filled Official CDPH 530 generation so the PDF stays visible in the current modal with an embedded preview plus explicit Open PDF, Share / Save PDF, and Download PDF actions, avoiding the disappearing/blank transient-tab behavior on mobile.
  • Preserved the original unmodified CDPH 530 template underneath the filled fields, handwritten signature spaces, CNA/Observation separation, nursing workflows, History, cloud sync, and existing assignment calculations.
v4.22.35 · Visible Filled Official 530 Action
  • Placed Prepare Filled Official CDPH 530 PDF directly inside the finalized-revision card where mobile users can see it.
  • Removed the confusing Facility Internal Sheet action from the Official 530 preparation card.
  • Made the Official 530 footer sticky on phones so the filled-PDF action remains reachable while scrolling.
  • Preserved Observation cards in both CNA Assignments and the Review preview.
v4.22.34 · Observation Cards in CNA Assignments
  • Added a dedicated assignment card for every active Observation room directly inside Step 4 · CNA Assignments.
  • Each card shows the assigned Observation CNA, room and beds, resident count, separate-coverage label, and break time.
  • Unassigned Observation coverage is shown clearly before finalization instead of disappearing from the main assignment list.
  • Observation remains separate from regular floor runs and does not change floor-CNA counts, resident distribution, or workload balancing.
v4.22.33 · Facility All-Staff Official Paper
  • Every assigned CNA and nurse from the finalized shift is now included automatically on Official CDPH 530; no per-row selection is required.
  • Catered Cottage Healthcare prefills employee name, discipline, nursing-services assignment, clock-in/out, and scheduled meal-break start/end. Supervisors can edit times and should verify actual times before signatures.
  • Removed the blank state-website action. The built-in original CDPH 530 remains the automatic template, with Select / Replace PDF available only for a newer controlled form.
  • Employee and DON/designee signature spaces remain blank for original handwritten signatures, with additional original page-1 copies generated for more than seven staff.
v4.22.32 · Clear Filled-vs-Blank Paper Actions
  • Renamed the blank-form action to View Blank Form on CDPH Website so it is no longer mistaken for the generated printout.
  • Renamed the generated action to Prepare Filled CDPH 530 PDF.
  • Added a prominent Print All-Staff Generated Sign-In Sheet action for the finalized/preloaded staffing assignment while keeping CDPH 530 eligibility tied to payroll-capture rules.
  • No staffing calculations, CNA/Observation separation, security, cloud sync, or official-form layout changed.
v4.22.31 · Official 530 Eligibility Guidance
  • Clarified that CNA certification does not determine CDPH 530 eligibility; the deciding question is whether direct-care hours are otherwise captured in payroll records.
  • Added clear guidance that ordinary payroll CNAs normally use the Facility Internal Sheet, while applicable registry/contract, salaried/dual-role, corporate, or other missing-payroll direct-care hours may require CDPH 530.
  • When zero rows are selected, the screen now explains that this may be correct and provides direct actions to reopen the revision or use the Facility Internal Sheet.
  • No staffing calculations, CNA/Observation separation, security, cloud sync, or official-form layout changed.
v4.22.30 · Official 530 Blank-Signature Preservation
  • Corrected a PDF flattening artifact that could reveal hidden guide X marks in employee and DON/designee signature areas.
  • The Official CDPH 530 now keeps all signature spaces visibly blank for original handwritten signatures while retaining the completed facility, date, shift, assignment, employee, discipline, and time fields.
  • No staffing calculations, CNA/Observation separation, schedules, authentication, cloud sync, History, facility-internal printing, or other interface behavior changed.
v4.22.29 · CNA Preload Math & Official 530 Typography Polish
  • Corrected Preload Scheduled CNAs so the regular floor preload never exceeds the calculated Floor Target. Example: 9 total CNA target with 2 Observation positions now preloads 7 floor CNAs plus 2 Observation CNAs, not 9 floor CNAs.
  • Existing/manual Observation CNA names are treated as part of the same certified CNA pool and are excluded from regular floor preload when they match the dated roster.
  • Changed the Official CDPH 530 Nursing Services Assignment entry for regular floor CNAs to a compact first-to-last range such as 2A-6A instead of listing every individual bed.
  • Polished the original Official CDPH 530 direct-fill output with larger, centered Helvetica text in the official fillable fields. Facility/date/DON/shift-start/location and staff-row values are centered with adaptive font sizing so the completed state form is cleaner and easier to read while retaining the original CDPH form underneath.
  • Employee and DON/designee signature areas remain untouched for original handwritten signatures. No official labels, borders, instructions, form number, or layout are redrawn.
  • Preserved Census/Bed Status, CNA/Observation separation, Nursing, monthly schedules, History, authentication/2FA, Supabase sync, Official-vs-Internal print separation, and the rebuilt Windows launcher.
v4.22.28 · Observation / Floor Assignment Separation Fix
  • Fixed CNA generation so Observation CNAs stay separate from regular floor assignments even though both come from the same certified CNA staff pool.
  • When a CNA already listed on a regular floor run is assigned to Observation, Catered Cottage Healthcare now moves that CNA out of the floor list and reduces the regular floor-assignment count instead of counting the same CNA twice.
  • Added a defensive generation check that removes any legacy/manual duplicate name appearing in both Observation and a regular floor assignment before resident workloads are generated.
  • Regular floor name entry now warns and rejects a CNA who is already assigned to Observation; clear or change the Observation assignment first when moving that CNA back to the floor.
  • Clarified staffing labels to show Floor CNAs separately from Observation coverage. Example: 9 total CNAs with 2 assigned to Observation generates 7 regular floor assignments plus 2 separate Observation assignments.
  • Preserved the unified CNA pool, scheduled CNA preload, official CDPH 530 direct-fill workflow, CNA/Nursing schedule import, Census/Bed Status, Nursing, History, cloud sync, authentication/2FA, and Windows launcher behavior.
v4.22.27 · Windows Launcher Rebuild & Desktop Reliability
  • Rebuilt the Windows launcher from scratch as a standard Windows x64 executable instead of the earlier custom portable PE wrapper that some Windows 10/11 systems rejected with “This app can’t run on your PC.”
  • The new standalone launcher embeds the exact v4.22.27 desktop app and original CDPH 530 (06/19), extracts them to a stable per-user Catered Cottage Healthcare folder, and opens the app through the normal Windows file association.
  • Added a clear Windows error dialog if extraction or browser launch fails instead of silently failing.
  • Embedded the original CDPH 530 directly in the desktop HTML as the built-in Official 530 template, so the official form workflow can use the real state PDF without requiring a first-time manual template selection. Users may still replace it when CDPH publishes a newer controlled form.
  • Preserved all v4.22.26 staffing fixes: unified CNA/Observation staffing pool, Observation preload behavior, CNA/Nursing schedule import routing, Official-vs-Internal print separation, real CDPH 530 direct fill, Census/Bed Status, History, Supabase sync, authentication/2FA, viewer restrictions, and existing assignment logic.
v4.22.26 · Unified CNA Observation Model & Schedule Import Routing
  • Clarified the staffing model so Observation / Sitter is a shift assignment for the same certified CNA pool, not a separate employee type. Any scheduled CNA may work a regular floor run or Observation based on the active census/coverage need.
  • Changed dated CNA preload logic so active Observation coverage is driven by the current Observation census. Older monthly schedule Observation tags are treated only as placement hints and no longer create an Observation staffing need when no Observation beds are active.
  • Preserved manually entered Observation names, avoids duplicate CNA names across floor and Observation assignments, and continues filling only available Observation slots.
  • Added a single More → Import Schedule chooser with CNA Staff and Nursing Staff paths. CNA imports continue to update the CNA monthly calendar/prediction history; Nursing imports route to the Nursing Monthly Schedule importer.
  • Kept PSA as an optional/historical special role without using PSA as the default Observation staffing model.
  • Reconfirmed the official CDPH 530 path uses the real original uploaded CDPH 530 PDF. Field 5 contains only the official shift start time, while employee rows keep actual start/end times. Official employee and DON/designee signature spaces remain blank for handwritten signatures.
  • The official 530 continues to pull patient assignments from finalized Catered Cottage Healthcare staffing generated from the current census/bed status; the official form itself has no separate census-count field, so Catered Cottage Healthcare does not add one or alter the state template.
  • Preserved the v4.22.24 Observation preload fix, v4.22.25 Official-vs-Internal print clarity, CNA/Nursing assignment logic, History, authentication/2FA, Supabase sync, viewer restrictions, and existing print behavior.
v4.22.25 · Official 530 Workflow Clarity & Bug Fixes
  • Fixed the finalized staffing-sheet Official CDPH 530 action so it calls the actual direct-fill workflow instead of a missing function name.
  • Renamed and visually separated the two outputs: Prepare / Print Official CDPH 530 uses the original state PDF, while Print Facility Staffing Sheet (Internal) remains the complete operational Catered Cottage Healthcare list.
  • Added a finalized-state explainer so supervisors can immediately see which output is official and which is internal, and disabled Official 530 until the staffing revision is finalized.
  • Updated History actions to show Official CDPH 530 and Facility Internal explicitly, preventing accidental printing of the internal sheet as if it were the state form.
  • Preserved the v4.22.24 Observation CNA preload fix: regular CNAs preload to floor assignments while reserved/scheduled Observation CNAs populate available Observation slots without overwriting manually entered names.
  • Preserved the original CDPH 530 direct-field fill, seven-row page handling, handwritten signature areas, census/assignment logic, cloud sync, authentication, monthly schedules, and finalized history behavior.
v4.22.24 · Observation CNA Preload Fix
  • Fixed Preload Scheduled CNAs so CNA names reserved for active Observation coverage are loaded into available Observation / Sitter slots instead of loading only regular floor CNA names.
  • Preserves manually entered Observation names and fills only empty Observation slots, avoiding duplicates or destructive overwrites.
  • Explicit monthly-schedule Observation roles continue to preload normally; inferred Observation coverage now also uses the reserved scheduled CNA names calculated by the existing staffing logic.
  • Updated preload feedback and audit logging to report floor and Observation CNAs actually placed.
  • Preserved CNA targets, monthly schedules, special roles, assignment balancing, Census/Bed Status, Nursing, History, cloud sync, printing, and the official CDPH 530 direct-fill workflow.
v4.22.23 · Original CDPH 530 Direct Form Fill
  • Reworked the Official CDPH 530 workflow to use the actual fillable fields inside the original CDPH 530 PDF instead of visually recreating the form or relying on hand-tuned overlay coordinates.
  • Bundled the exact user-supplied official CDPH 530 (06/19) as the default template while preserving the option to replace it with a newer official controlled PDF later.

v4.22.22 · Official CDPH 530 Overlay & Documentation Polish
  • Added an Official CDPH 530 overlay workflow: Catered Cottage Healthcare uses the actual official PDF selected by the user as the unchanged background and places staffing data only into the form's blank completion areas instead of recreating or redesigning the state form.
  • The official blank PDF can be selected once and cached locally on the device; Catered Cottage Healthcare also keeps a direct View Blank Form on CDPH Website link for downloading the current CDPH-controlled form.
  • Added a per-staff Include on Official 530 control. Registry/contract, corporate, and salaried/dual-role rows default on; ordinary facility-employee rows default off and can be overridden when documentation rules require it.
  • Official 530 output is generated only from a finalized staffing revision, uses up to seven staff rows per copied official page 1, preserves the official instruction pages once at the end, leaves employee/DON signatures and meal-period fields blank for actual completion, and carries non-facility employment status inside the assignment entry without changing the form structure.
  • Replaced the generated employee-signature X in the Catered Cottage Healthcare facility-sheet editor with a blank handwritten-signature reminder.
  • Changed generated floor assignments to retain the specific bed list rather than collapsing every assignment into a first-to-last range, improving audit traceability.
  • Added optional X/Y alignment calibration for the PDF overlay, local template status, historical-revision CDPH 530 generation, and clear separation between the facility assignment sheet and the official state form.
  • Preserved CNA/Observation/Nursing assignment logic, monthly schedules, census, finalization/history, authentication/2FA, Supabase sync, viewer restrictions, and existing web/desktop behavior.
v4.22.21 · Compliance & Reliability Polish
  • Separated the Catered Cottage Healthcare facility staffing sheet from the official CDPH 530 workflow: the Catered Cottage Healthcare printout is now clearly labeled as a facility form and links to the unmodified official CDPH 530 when required.
  • Removed preprinted X marks from employee and DON/designee signature areas so handwritten original signatures can be collected on paper without a generated mark in the signature space.

v4.22.20 · Bed Status Overview Readability Polish

v4.22.19 · State Staffing Paper Print Spacing

v4.22.16 · Admin-Only Required Two-Factor Authentication
  • Changed mandatory authenticator-app 2FA so only Owner/Admin accounts are required to enroll and verify a second factor.

v4.22.15 · Password Recovery Reliability
  • Fixed the Forgot Password return URL so it no longer appends an unnecessary recovery query string that can conflict with Supabase Redirect URL allow-list matching.

  • Preserved the hosted-site security requirement, existing MFA checks, cloud roles, and all assignment/census/state-paper behavior.
v4.22.14 · Role-Specific Standard Shift Times
  • Added Apply Standard Shift Times to the editable DSD State Staffing Paper so actual start/end fields can be filled for all current staff rows with one action.
  • CNA/NA and other non-nursing rows use the standard 8-hour shift: 7:00 AM–3:00 PM, 3:00 PM–11:00 PM, or 11:00 PM–7:00 AM.
  • RN/LVN/LPT nursing rows use the same start time and a 30-minute-later end: 7:00 AM–3:30 PM, 3:00 PM–11:30 PM, or 11:00 PM–7:30 AM.
  • The action is manual only. After applying the standards, every individual Actual start/end field remains editable and custom times are preserved unless the user presses the button again.
  • Preserved Census, assignment generation, nursing assignments, State Paper finalization/history, printing, and cloud/local persistence behavior.
v4.22.13 · Authentication Version Label Consistency
  • Corrected stale version labels on the cloud sign-in, authenticator verification, device-lock, and staff quick-login screens so every active security surface now reports v4.22.13.

v4.22.12 · State-Form Shift Start Field Correction
  • Restored the State Staffing Assignment & Sign-In Sheet field 5 label to the facility/state-style SHIFT START TIME (HH:MM AM/PM) instead of renaming the layout field.

  • Removed the room-wide Room Actions menu from the main Census editor so individual bed status editing is the primary, uncluttered workflow.

  • Preserved census editing, finalized-shift lock behavior, interactive status legends, State Paper rules, and all prior v4.22.8 functionality.
v4.22.8 · Compact Room Actions & Census Lock Clarity
  • Replaced the four oversized room-wide census buttons with a compact Room Actions menu so individual bed editing remains the primary workflow and the room editor reaches bed controls sooner, especially on iPhone.
  • Added all five room-wide actions inside the menu: Resident Present, Observation, Expected Admission, Hospital, and Vacant. Hospital and Vacant require confirmation before changing every bed in the room.

  • Each status card is interactive: tapping a status filters the room navigator and jumps to the first matching room; tapping a listed bed such as 2A or 26B jumps directly to that bed and briefly highlights it.

  • Kept the optional care-load guidance separate from the status legend to reduce clutter while preserving all care-load features.

v4.22.6 · Resident & Bed Status Mobile Redesign
  • Redesigned the Resident & Bed Status room navigator on phones so the room picker is substantially taller and easier to scan instead of showing only a few rooms at a time.

v4.22.6 · Fresh-Shift State Paper Reset & Stale Nurse Cleanup
  • Added Reset to Current Shift for editable State Papers. It discards old/manual staffing rows and shift-specific notes in the current draft, then rebuilds the sheet only from the currently selected shift assignment, Observation/special roles, and current nursing assignments while keeping facility/DON header fields.
  • When viewing a finalized State Paper, the same action becomes New Paper from Current Shift, creating a fresh editable paper without copying old test/manual staff while preserving the finalized revision in History.

v4.22.2 · Mobile State Paper Cards & Compliance-Safe Printing

v4.22.1 · Full-Width State Paper Editor & Safe Preview Startup
  • Expanded the DSD State Staffing Paper editor to the same near-full-window footprint used by the CNA Monthly Calendar editor (up to 1500 px / 98vw), with a fixed modal frame, independently scrolling body, and full-screen tablet/mobile treatment.

v4.22.0 · DSD State Paper Workflow & Generated-Assignment Sync
  • Made the DSD Shift Planner the operational hub: Prepare Assignment now opens the selected date/shift directly in Staff or the existing generated Assignment, while Open State Paper opens that exact shift without returning to the generic Shift front page.
  • Rebuilt State Paper row sourcing so the generated shift assignment is the primary source of truth. Regular CNAs follow Assignment 1, 2, 3… order with exact generated room/bed text; Observation, Shower, RNA/Restorative, and other special CNA roles follow; nursing rows print last in Charge/Desk, Cart 1, Cart 2, Cart 3, Treatment, Float/Other order.
  • Fixed the v4.21 State Paper linkage bug that could show repeated “Assignment not generated” placeholders even after an assignment existed. Existing State Paper drafts now safely resync after a newly generated/re-generated assignment while preserving actual shift/meal entries, No Meal selections, status edits, and manual-only rows.
  • Changed State Paper meal handling so Actual Meal Break Start/End begin blank and are never copied from the planned break rotation. Missing meal times are readiness warnings rather than automatic blocking errors so actual times can be entered after meals occur.
  • Changed readiness UX so merely opening or editing the paper shows a neutral draft message. Validation runs only from Check Readiness or Finalize, and missing assignments are summarized instead of repeating a placeholder on every CNA row.
  • Added direct navigation back to the DSD Shift Planner from Staff, Assignment, and State Paper, plus a Generate / Prepare Assignment First action when the current shift has no generated assignment.
  • Preserved finalized State Paper revisions as immutable snapshots, handwritten employee/DON signature areas, unrestricted advance planning, monthly CNA/Nursing schedule workflows, Observation-inclusive CNA staffing math, cloud/local persistence, authentication privacy protections, and prior history.
v4.21.0 · DON/ADON Nursing Calendar + Schedule-Driven DSD Rosters
  • Added a separate Nursing Monthly Schedule with the same month/shift workflow used for CNA scheduling: saved months, W/OFF/RO day cells, nurse directory selection, credential and usual nursing-role fields, JSON import, import template export, and printable calendar view.
  • Nursing schedule editing is reserved to Owner/Admin and DON/ADON/Nursing Supervisor cloud roles. DSD/Scheduler may view and use the nursing calendar for daily staffing but cannot change the official monthly nursing schedule.
  • Updated the DSD Shift Planner to show the exact saved calendar names for the selected date/shift, grouped in professional categories: Nursing, Floor CNAs, Observation, Shower, RNA/Restorative, and Extra/Special.
  • Added Use Scheduled Staff from the DSD planner. It remains optional: it loads the dated CNA roster plus scheduled nurses into that shift workspace, after which DSD can remove a call-off, select a replacement, add called-in/extra staff, or change nursing assignments without altering the monthly calendars.
  • Added LPT as a first-class nursing credential and kept nursing calendar data in local/cloud workspace backups. Existing CNA schedule ownership, assignment balancing, state-paper signatures, finalized history, and observation math are unchanged.
v4.20.2 · Professional Observation Terminology
  • Updated formal DSD/state-paper terminology so observation coverage prints as Observation rather than OBS or Sitter.
  • Observation remains an assignment/coverage designation; the employee’s actual discipline continues to print separately as CNA, RN, LVN, LPT, or other applicable credential.
  • Changed DSD staffing-category labels from OBS to Observation while preserving all existing observation-room, staffing-count, and assignment logic.
  • No staffing calculations, room assignments, employee signatures, finalized history, or cloud data behavior were changed.
v4.20.1 · Unrestricted DSD Advance Planning
  • Removed any implied timing restriction from DSD assignment preparation. DSD can prepare Day, Evening, or Night for any selected patient-day date regardless of the current time.
  • Confirmed the DSD planner date field has no minimum or maximum date lock, so assignments may be prepared tomorrow, several days ahead, weeks ahead, or farther in advance when operationally useful.
  • Renamed the Today-only wording to DSD Shift Planner and added Today, Tomorrow, and +7 Days shortcuts while keeping the date field fully editable.
  • Clarified that automatic shift-preparation windows are convenience suggestions only and never block manual/DSD planning.
  • Updated Day, Evening, and Night guidance so recommended preparation times are operational suggestions—not permissions or restrictions. Existing per-date/per-shift draft preservation, state-paper workflow, call-off handling, signatures, cloud persistence, and finalized history remain unchanged.
v4.20.0 · DSD Daily Shift Board & Ahead-of-Shift Preparation
  • Added a dedicated Today’s DSD Shift Board for the three normal shifts: Day 7 AM–3 PM, Evening 3 PM–11 PM, and Night 11 PM–7 AM. DSD can jump directly to any shift for the selected date instead of waiting for automatic shift targeting.
  • Added DSD-specific preparation guidance: Evening can be prepared a few hours before 3 PM and adjusted for call-offs before handoff; Night can be prepared and printed before DSD leaves around 5 PM even though the shift starts at 11 PM.
  • Added persistent multi-shift assignment workspaces so starting the Evening or Night assignment no longer wipes an unfinished roster/draft for another shift. Each date/shift keeps its own regular CNA roster, generated assignment draft, Observation/Sitter and Shower Team context until reopened.
  • The DSD board shows each shift’s assignment status, roster count, saved monthly-schedule count when available, and State Staffing Paper status, with direct buttons to prepare the assignment or open the paper.
  • Added a late-call-off workflow reminder: after DSD has left, staff can document any later staffing change on the printed paper according to facility policy, while Catered Cottage Healthcare preserves the DSD-issued electronic version and revision history.
  • Preserved employee handwritten-signature areas, Nursing Directory suggestions, finalized state-paper revisions, cloud persistence, OBS-inclusive staffing math, and all prior v4.19.2 behavior.
v4.19.2 · Employee Signature & Nurse Roster Workflow
  • Matched the facility sample more closely by labeling the DSD worksheet and printed state-paper column Employee Signature and placing a clear X signing marker in every printed employee-signature cell while leaving the rest of the cell blank for the employee's original handwritten signature.
  • Added a dedicated + Add Nurse action inside the DSD State Staffing Paper so DSD can add an RN/LVN directly without first leaving the state-paper workflow.
  • Added Nursing Directory/CNA name suggestions to the DSD employee-name field. RN/LVN names entered on the state-paper worksheet are remembered in the Nursing Directory after the field is committed, but are not automatically assigned to future shifts.
  • Changed state-paper nurse assignments to the facility-style labels Desk, Cart 1, Cart 2, Cart 3, Treatment, and Float / Other instead of long placeholder text.
  • Saved nursing assignments are now eligible to flow into the DSD state paper even when the optional Nursing Staff panel is currently hidden, preventing previously entered nurse names from disappearing from the finalized staffing paper.
  • Preserved v4.19.1's sample-matched print layout, finalized revision history, handwritten-signature requirement, CNA/OBS staffing logic, cloud persistence, and existing assignment workflow.
v4.19.1 · State Paper Sample Layout Match
  • Updated the finalized DSD State Staffing Paper printout to closely follow the facility/state sample supplied by Arnold: portrait letter format, numbered facility/date/DON/shift/unit fields, Shift 1/2/3 indicator, and the same compact sign-in table order.
  • Changed the printed table to Nursing Services Assignment, Employee Name, Discipline, Actual Shift Start/End, Actual Meal/Break Start/End, and Employee Signature. Catered Cottage Healthcare still keeps richer source/status details internally without cluttering the signed paper.
  • Combined start/end values and meal/break values into the same paper columns used by the sample while preserving exact time fields in the editable DSD workflow.
  • Added a sample-style DON/designee verification statement and signature line. Employee and DON/designee signature areas remain blank for original handwritten signatures.
  • Mapped Catered Cottage Healthcare Day / Evening / Night to paper Shift 1 / 2 / 3 and kept revision/finalization audit information in small footer text without presenting the Catered Cottage Healthcare sheet as an official state-agency form.
  • Preserved v4.19.0 state-paper history, revisions, readiness checks, cloud persistence, nursing/CNA/direct-care roster building, and all earlier stabilization fixes.
v4.19.0 · DSD Finalized State Staffing Paper
  • Expanded the DSD staffing worksheet into a complete state-paper workflow: Prepare, verify actual staffing, Finalize, preserve a locked revision in History, and print for original employee and DON/designee signatures.
  • Added persistent state-paper drafts and finalized paper history to local backups and cloud workspace payloads, keyed by patient-day date and shift.
  • Added automatic RN/LVN/CNA/direct-care roster building from the current CNA assignments, Observation / Sitter coverage, Shower Team, Other / Special CNA Role, and Nursing Staff, plus manual Add Direct-Care Staff rows for registry, relief, or other qualifying caregivers.
  • Added required/readiness checks for facility, unit/location, DON/designee, full employee name, discipline, specific nursing assignment, actual start/end times, and meal start/end or No meal. Placeholder assignments must be corrected before finalization.
  • Added call-off/vacancy/correction notes, discipline totals, beginning census, shift start time, assignment-finalization linkage, finalized-by/date/time/revision metadata, and immutable revision history.
  • Added Reopen / New Revision so staffing changes can be corrected without overwriting the earlier finalized paper. Previous revisions remain available to view and reprint from History.
  • Printing now uses the locked finalized snapshot, labels it as a facility-created Nursing Staffing Assignment & Sign-In Sheet, leaves original signature fields blank, and includes DON/designee verification/signature lines. Finalizing in Catered Cottage Healthcare is not treated as an employee or DON signature.
  • Preserved all v4.18.0 stabilization fixes, cloud/auth protections, assignment history, monthly schedules, OBS-inclusive staffing math, and existing assignment printing.
v4.18.0 · Daily Staffing Sign-In Worksheet & Stabilization Release
  • Added a new Daily Staffing & Sign-In worksheet for DSD / Scheduler and daily-assignment workflows. It auto-fills the prepared shift, date, census, floor CNA room/bed assignments, Observation / Sitter coverage, Other / Special CNA roles, Shower Team context, and optional Nursing Staff already entered in Catered Cottage Healthcare.
  • Added editable staffing-document fields for facility/location, DON or designee, preparer, employee discipline, exact nursing assignment, shift start/end, meal start/end, employment status, and a blank original-signature line for each employee.
  • Added a print-isolated landscape document so the staffing worksheet prints by itself without exposing the live Catered Cottage Healthcare workspace. The printed page contains no resident names and includes DON/designee verification and signature lines.
  • Added direct access from Review & Finalize and More Tools, plus Refresh From Current Shift so the worksheet can be regenerated after staffing or assignment changes.
  • Added an official CDPH 530 link and a clear compliance notice: the Catered Cottage Healthcare worksheet is a preparation/working copy and does not claim to replace the current official CDPH 530 when that form is required.
  • Preserved the v4.17.1 total-CNA/Observation floor math, v4.17.2 authentication privacy shield, optional manual preload behavior, saved monthly schedules, password recovery, cloud roles, assignment balancing, finalized History, and existing assignment printing.
v4.17.2 · Secure Sign-In Screen & Workspace Privacy Fix
  • Fixed the mobile sign-in bug where the main Catered Cottage Healthcare workspace could remain visible underneath the cloud sign-in card before authentication.
  • Added a true authentication shield that hides and makes the main workspace non-interactive until the cloud account is verified, including during sign-in, password recovery, MFA, Staff invite/PIN screens, and Device PIN lock.
  • Hardened iPhone/iPad auth screens to fill the dynamic viewport with their own opaque scroll surface so scrolling the sign-in card cannot reveal staffing, census, assignment, or schedule content behind it.
  • Kept the shield active while a saved cloud session is being re-verified on startup; previously verified non-staff accounts can still use the existing offline fallback when allowed.
  • Preserved cloud roles, MFA requirements, Staff / Alerts portal behavior, password recovery, Device PIN recovery, monthly schedules, staffing logic, printing, and finalized History.
v4.17.1 · Observation-Inclusive Staffing & iPhone Calendar Print Isolation
  • Corrected daily staffing math so Staffing Target is the total CNA headcount. Observation CNAs are included inside that total instead of being added on top.
  • Floor Target now subtracts active Observation coverage and saved non-floor special roles. Example: Total CNA Target 9 with 2 Observation rooms produces Floor Target 7.
  • Floor Scheduled now reserves Observation positions even when an older/imported monthly schedule marked all working CNAs as Floor and did not identify the sitter names.
  • Preload Scheduled CNAs now loads only the floor-sized roster. Explicit monthly OBS names still preload into Observation / Sitter; when the monthly schedule does not identify who should cover OBS, Catered Cottage Healthcare leaves those names for the supervisor instead of guessing.
  • Added an Observation note showing how many CNA positions are already included in the Total CNA Target but still need sitter placement.
  • Reworked Monthly CNA Schedule printing for iPhone/iPad so the live Catered Cottage Healthcare workspace is physically detached during the print snapshot. Only the monthly calendar remains in the print document, preventing assignment/navigation pages from leaking into Print / Save PDF.
  • Preserved landscape schedule formatting, assignment print isolation, monthly schedule history, bulk targets, preload Undo, cloud permissions, password recovery, and finalized History.
v4.17.0 · Saved Month History, Floor Staffing & Cloud Recovery
  • Removed the 72-schedule cap from normalization, import, editor saves, and bundled-data merging. All retained months remain in local backups and cloud payloads until explicitly archived; previously deleted months require a backup or protected archive restore.
  • Added all-saved-month selectors and obvious previous/next calendar navigation, including clear empty-month states. Unsaved editor changes require confirmation before switching months.
  • Expanded calendar and editor to near-full desktop width. At 1000px and above, the 31-day grid uses flexible columns; smaller devices retain the established full-screen scroll behavior.
  • Staff now shows Total CNA Target, Observation, Other Special, Floor Target, Floor Scheduled, Floor Entered and Floor Unfilled. A total of 9 with 2 Observation CNAs produces a floor target of 7. Other special roles are also excluded from floor coverage.
  • Manual Preload loads only floor CNAs into regular rows, ignores out-of-range preferred runs when sizing rows, fills available special-role positions without overwriting existing names, and identifies scheduled special-role staff still needing placement. Undo restores staffing and special-role visibility.
  • Saved monthly role badges now reflect the saved schedule instead of being silently replaced by later finalized assignment roles.
  • Added Forgot password, recovery email, verified Create New Password and authenticator support. Recovery credentials are removed from the URL, held only in memory, and never open the workspace; users sign in normally after resetting. Change My Password remains available in Settings and the signed-in account menu.
  • Added server-authorized Send Password Reset for the owner and DSD / Scheduler managers (lower-role accounts only). Existing role edits, removal, invites, email settings, staff PINs and MFA policies stay with the existing management service.
  • Re-adding an email now searches existing Auth accounts first and atomically relinks workspace membership without changing the existing password or an active member role. A password is required only when creating a truly new account.
  • Supplied an additive account-recovery Edge Function and SQL setup with active-session checks, protected owner handling, reset throttling, and durable admin audit records containing no passwords or recovery tokens. Requires deployment and Supabase Auth redirect/SMTP setup. Temporary-password override is intentionally omitted; secure recovery email is the supported assisted-reset path.
v4.16.27 · Staff Workflow Cleanup & Safer Optional Preload
  • Made monthly-roster preload fully optional: changing the prepared date/shift no longer auto-fills CNA names. Exact same-date/same-shift drafts still restore; otherwise the new shift starts with clean regular CNA names and the supervisor may choose Preload or Use Suggested Roster manually.
  • Removed Preload Scheduled CNAs from Shift Prep so Shift stays a staffing/status check. Preload now lives in one clear place: Staff → CNA Assignments.
  • Made CNA Assignments the first Staff workflow and added a live staffing strip for Target, Scheduled, Entered, and Open need, plus an exact monthly-schedule source line so supervisors can see what Preload would use before pressing it.
  • Improved preload feedback: successful loads briefly show “Loaded N CNAs ✓”; missing schedules identify the exact prepared date/shift; staffing targets continue to preserve blank assignment rows when planned need exceeds the dated roster.
  • Renamed clearing actions for clarity: Clear CNA Names affects regular Assignment rows only; Clear All Shift Staff clears CNA, Observation, Shower, Special Role, and Nursing names and still requires confirmation.
  • Added staffing Undo for individual Assignment clears and bulk staff clears, with a short-lived Undo bar inside CNA Assignments.
  • Kept special-role fields separate during regular preload, compacted Observation / Sitter further, and reordered Staff to CNA Assignments → Observation / Sitter → Shower Team → Other / Special CNA Role → Nursing Staff.
  • Made the CNA action bar compact/sticky on phones and added clear finalized/read-only messaging so edit controls visibly disable with Reopen to edit guidance.
  • Preserved census, monthly schedules, directories, role data, cloud permissions, assignment balancing, finalized History, printing, and existing schedule comparison logic.
v4.16.26 · Clear All CNA Assignment Names
  • Added a clear, section-level Clear All Names control directly inside the CNA Assignments section beside Preload Scheduled CNAs and CNA Directory.
  • The new action clears only the regular Assignment 1, 2, 3, and later CNA names. Observation / Sitter, Shower Team, Other / Special CNA Role, and Nursing Staff names are intentionally preserved.
  • Individual red Clear name controls remain available on every assignment row, and the separate whole-shift clear action remains available outside this section for supervisors who intentionally want to clear every staffing area.
v4.16.25 · CNA Assignment Section & Compact Observation
  • Reorganized the top of Staff around a dedicated CNA Assignments section so the normal floor-assignment workflow is visually separate from Observation / Sitter and other special roles.
  • Placed Preload Scheduled CNAs at the top of the CNA Assignments section, with Clear All Shift Names and CNA Directory directly underneath for a clear start-of-shift workflow.
  • Moved CNAs Working, fair remainder settings, light-load guidance, and Assignment 1, 2, 3… rows into the same CNA Assignments section so supervisors no longer have to scroll past special-role panels before reaching regular assignments.
  • Made Observation / Sitter more compact on phones with shorter guidance, tighter spacing, smaller controls, and a simplified header while preserving per-room coverage, names, clear actions, and audit behavior.
  • Preserved exact monthly-schedule preload logic, per-assignment Clear name buttons, Shower Team, Nursing Staff, cloud permissions, assignment balancing, and print behavior.
v4.16.24 · Staff Preload Panel Visibility
  • Fixed Guided/mobile Staff view hiding the entire Shift Staff action toolbar. The root cause was the Guided-mode CSS intentionally hiding Staff header section tools.
  • Added a dedicated Shift Staff Setup panel directly above Observation / Sitter so Preload Scheduled CNAs is always visible where staffing is entered.
  • Added Clear All Shift Names and CNA Directory beside the preload workflow in the same mobile-friendly panel while keeping the existing Overview header tools unchanged.
  • The new Staff panel calls the same fixed dated-roster preload logic from v4.16.23, so both Staff and Review use one consistent monthly-schedule source.
  • Preserved per-assignment Clear name controls, monthly schedules, special roles, cloud permissions, assignment balancing, and print behavior.
v4.16.23 · Preload Reliability & Per-Assignment Clear
  • Fixed Shift Prep getting stuck on “Checking…” and the Shift Prep buttons appearing unresponsive by moving the late Settings and Shift Prep modules back into the main Catered Cottage Healthcare runtime scope where they can access the live app state safely.
  • Fixed Preload Scheduled CNAs so it now reads the exact saved Monthly CNA Schedule for the prepared date and shift, loads only CNAs marked W for that date, and no longer substitutes routine/history predictions.
  • Preload now still respects the saved daily Staffing Target: it keeps blank assignment rows when the target is higher than the scheduled roster, while always keeping every CNA actually scheduled to work.
  • Added an individual Clear Name action beneath every regular Assignment row, beside Choose from directory, so Assignment 1, 2, 3, and the rest can be cleared one at a time without affecting other staff.
  • Kept monthly schedules, special-role expectations, finalized history, cloud permissions, census, assignment balancing, and existing bulk clear tools unchanged.
v4.16.22 · Shift Prep Dashboard & Staffing Comparison
  • Added a compact Shift Prep staffing dashboard that works in both Guided Shift view and Overview, showing the prepared date/shift, Staffing Target, monthly Scheduled count, Entered named CNAs, and exact roster matches.
  • Added a live Scheduled vs. Entered comparison using the exact saved Monthly CNA Schedule for the prepared date/shift. Missing scheduled CNAs and extra/replacement names are identified without changing the roster automatically.
  • Added Review Differences with separate Missing Scheduled, Extra / Replacement, and Scheduled Roster & Roles lists. Monthly OBS, Shower, RNA, and Extra role expectations are shown as compact role badges for review.
  • Added direct Shift Prep actions for Preload Scheduled CNAs, Start Clean, Open Staff, and View Calendar. Editing actions automatically disable for finalized shifts and read-only cloud roles.
  • The comparison updates as staffing names change and after shift changes, cloud loads, monthly schedule saves, preloads, and clear-name actions.
  • Corrected stale version labels in the cloud sign-in and Settings About areas while preserving all existing security, cloud, assignment, print, schedule, target, and iPhone modal behavior.
v4.16.21 · Shift Preload, Clear Names & Bulk Staffing Targets
  • Added Preload Scheduled CNAs to the Staff header. It loads the exact dated monthly CNA schedule for the prepared date/shift and uses that day’s Staffing Target when sizing the regular CNA rows.
  • Prevented previous-shift CNA names from silently carrying into a new shift when no matching saved draft exists. Existing same-date/same-shift drafts still restore normally.
  • Added Clear All Shift Names for one-action cleanup of regular CNA names, Shower Team, Observation / Sitter, Other / Special CNA Role, and Nursing Staff without deleting Census, directories, monthly schedules, or finalized History.
  • Added section-level Clear Names controls for regular CNAs, Shower Team, Observation / Sitter, Special Role, and Nursing Staff so one section can be reset without affecting the others.
  • Added Monthly Schedule bulk Staffing Target tools: enter one target and Apply to All Days, or Clear All Targets to 0. Individual daily targets remain editable afterward.

v4.16.20 · iPhone Modal Scroll Isolation
  • Fixed the remaining iPhone issue where swiping inside the Monthly CNA Schedule moved the Catered Cottage Healthcare page behind the popup instead of scrolling the schedule workspace.

  • Added touch routing for vertical swipes that begin on the horizontally scrollable CNA calendar so vertical movement scrolls the popup while horizontal swipes still move through dates.

v4.16.19 · iPhone Monthly Schedule Scroll Fix

v4.16.18 · Professional Schedule Workspace & iPhone Print Fixes

v4.16.16 · Cleaner Monthly Role UI
  • Simplified the Monthly CNA Schedule editor so regular Floor coverage is now the default and no longer consumes a large selector on every row.

v4.16.15 · Task-Based Settings Organization
  • Reorganized Settings into eight task-based categories: Staff & Directories, Scheduling & Shift Rules, Assignments & Workload, Display & Printing, Account & Security, Cloud & Administration, Data & Maintenance, and Help & About.
  • Split the old mixed General Settings section so Interface Mode now lives with Display, Automatic Shift Preparation lives with Scheduling, and CNA staffing defaults live with Staff & Directories.
  • Added a horizontal category selector and kept only one Settings category visible at a time, with the last-used category remembered on the device.
  • Added Search Settings with direct results that switch to the correct category, open the matching subsection, and scroll it into view.
  • Cloud & Administration automatically disappears when the signed-in role has no visible administrative settings; existing Owner/Admin-only controls and server permissions remain unchanged.
  • Reorganized Data & Maintenance actions into Backup & Restore, Import Data, and clearly separated Maintenance groups without changing the underlying actions.
