v4.16.14 · Role-Based Optional 2FA
  • Adjusted the MFA policy so Owner/Admin and DSD / Scheduler still require authenticator-app 2FA, while Supervisor (LVN/RN), Viewer, and Staff / Alerts may enable 2FA voluntarily.
  • Optional MFA remains meaningful: once an optional-role account enrolls a verified authenticator, Catered Cottage Healthcare requires that authenticator on future cloud sign-ins for that account.
  • Updated Supabase RLS to match the app policy: Supervisor can use normal email/password when no authenticator is enrolled, while Owner/Admin and DSD / Scheduler still require AAL2.
  • Supervisor device-PIN recovery can now use cloud email/password without mandatory MFA. If that Supervisor has voluntarily enabled 2FA, the authenticator is still required during sign-in.
  • Persisted the local “MFA enabled” cache flag so optional-MFA accounts cannot silently lose their 2FA requirement during offline/reload handling.
  • Updated Account Security wording and required-factor protection to match the new role policy.
  • Preserved Admin-only cloud settings, monthly schedule protections, role permissions, automatic cloud sync, PIN-local-only behavior, schedule printing, staffing targets, predictions, and assignment logic.
v4.16.13 · Secure Device-PIN Recovery
  • Changed the shared-workstation PIN into a clearly device-only convenience lock. It no longer accepts or advertises an embedded Creator Master PIN.
  • Removed the legacy hard-coded Creator Master PIN verifier from the app source. Privileged recovery now uses the real Supabase cloud account plus authenticator-app MFA.
  • Added Forgot PIN? Verify Cloud Account directly on the device lock screen. Owner/Admin, DSD / Scheduler, and Supervisor can securely recover a device PIN with email/password followed by required MFA.
  • After successful cloud + MFA verification, Catered Cottage Healthcare requires a new 4–8 digit device PIN before unlocking; the old PIN is replaced only after the new PIN is saved.
  • The device PIN and its salt remain local-device data and stay excluded from cloud synchronization and exported backups.
  • Added a Back to Device PIN path during cloud recovery and clearer error messages so a cloud password is no longer mistaken for the local PIN.
  • Preserved role permissions, Admin-only cloud settings, monthly schedule protections, automatic cloud sync, schedule printing, staffing targets, predictions, and assignment logic.
v4.16.12 · Overview Monthly Schedule Access
  • Added a dedicated Monthly CNA Schedule card directly to Overview so monthly scheduling is no longer hidden only under More Tools.
  • The Overview card shows the current month and effective shift, whether a saved schedule exists, and the current roster count when available.
  • Owner/Admin and DSD / Scheduler see both View Calendar and Create / Edit Schedule from Overview.
  • Supervisor (LVN/RN desk nurse) and Viewer see View Calendar only. Staff / Alerts does not see the monthly schedule card.
  • Kept More Tools and the Monthly Schedule Calendar toolbar as secondary access paths, with the same role protections.
  • Monthly schedule edit/import permissions remain enforced by the existing UI gates and Supabase server-side scheduleHistory protection.
  • Refreshed the Overview summary after schedule saves and normal app renders, and corrected the remaining stale sidebar version pill.
  • No assignment balancing, staffing-target learning, 4-on/2-off prediction, cloud-settings permissions, monthly print behavior, or finalized-assignment logic changed.
v4.16.11 · Pre-Deploy QA & Permission Hardening
  • Tightened monthly schedule authorization so Create/Edit/Import controls require a resolved Owner/Admin or DSD / Scheduler role instead of temporarily allowing schedule changes while cloud identity is unknown.
  • Hardened monthly schedule import with the same strict role check used by the Schedule Maker.
  • Adjusted the Supabase workspace-save conflict path so a newer cloud revision is handled as a normal sync conflict before Supervisor schedule protections are evaluated, preventing misleading permission errors after a DSD updates the monthly schedule.
  • Corrected two-factor-authentication wording to include DSD / Scheduler alongside Owner/Admin and Supervisor.
  • Removed stale v4.16.3 labels from current lock, staff PIN, and printed-handoff UI so troubleshooting output now reports the active app version.
  • Ran pre-deploy static QA: JavaScript syntax validation, duplicate-ID scan, core DOM reference review, role-gating review, and current schedule/print/cloud-path inspection.
  • No assignment balancing mathematics, resident/census data structures, staffing-target learning, 4-on/2-off prediction, role pills, print-layout logic, or finalized-assignment behavior was intentionally changed.
v4.16.10 · DSD / Supervisor Role Separation & Admin-Only Cloud Settings
  • Separated the old combined DSD/Supervisor permission into two real cloud roles. DSD / Scheduler can create daily CNA assignments and create/edit/import monthly CNA schedules; Supervisor (LVN/RN desk nurse) can create and manage daily CNA assignments but cannot change monthly CNA schedule history.
  • Preserved existing legacy DSD/Scheduler membership by migrating the previous supervisor-backed scheduler role to the new dedicated scheduler role.
  • Added server-side protection to the workspace save RPC so Supervisor accounts cannot bypass the UI and modify monthly scheduleHistory data.
  • Made the Supabase / Cloud Sync Settings section Owner/Admin-only. DSD and Supervisor accounts still sync their permitted work automatically after sign-in, but cannot open cloud connection/management controls in Settings.
  • Updated Owner/Admin People management so new and existing users can be assigned DSD / Scheduler or Supervisor (LVN/RN) independently.
  • Owner/Admin, DSD / Scheduler, and Supervisor continue to require authenticator-app 2FA. Viewer remains read/print only and Staff / Alerts remains personal-assignment only.
  • Protected cloud archive/recovery and destructive cloud history maintenance are now Owner/Admin-only administrative functions.
  • Preserved v4.16.9 independent Staffing Target vs Scheduled logic, variance, next-month learning, fixed-day/4-2/on-call patterns, schedule print fix, and assignment balancing.
v4.16.9 · Independent Staffing Targets & Variance
  • Separated Daily Scheduled from Staffing Target so the target is now a true planning need instead of automatically mirroring the number of CNAs already scheduled.
  • New monthly schedules start from the configured shift staffing default, or from independently saved historical targets by weekday when available. Existing legacy manual schedules whose targets exactly mirrored every scheduled count are treated as legacy mirrored targets and shown with an independent planning target instead.
  • Added a live Variance row to the Schedule Maker: Scheduled − Target, with positive, negative, and zero values updating immediately as work cells or targets change.
  • Suggest Next Month now learns staffing need only from schedules that explicitly saved independent targets; it no longer learns a target by falling back to the actual number of CNAs scheduled.
  • DSD / Scheduler can still deliberately choose Set Targets = Scheduled, but that is now an explicit action rather than the default behavior. Manual target edits remain independent and do not add or remove CNAs automatically.
  • Saved monthly schedules now mark their staffing targets as independent planning data so future predictions can learn true staffing need separately from actual coverage.
  • Preserved fixed weekday learning, flexible 4-on/2-off rotation, on-call/random placement, RO exceptions, role pills, schedule printing, cloud sync, and assignment logic.
v4.16.8 · Desktop Monthly Schedule Print Fix
  • Fixed Monthly CNA Schedule Calendar Print / Save PDF showing a blank preview on desktop browsers when a CNA assignment had previously been generated.
  • Separated the monthly-schedule print mode from Catered Cottage Healthcare' isolated CNA-assignment print staging so the two print systems can no longer hide each other during the browser beforeprint event.
  • Monthly schedule printing now clears any stale assignment print stage before rendering the schedule and explicitly prevents assignment staging while print-schedule mode is active.
  • Added a defensive print-style override so the monthly schedule remains visible even if a browser briefly overlaps print-mode classes during preview startup.
  • Preserved landscape schedule formatting, mobile/iPad printing, CNA names, W/OFF/RO cells, staffing targets, role colors, schedule prediction, cloud sync, and normal CNA assignment printing.
v4.16.7 · Unified Compact Schedule Maker
  • Redesigned the real Monthly Schedule Maker on both mobile and desktop to match the approved Catered Cottage Healthcare mockups.
  • Removed the permanent Role column entirely. Each CNA now has a compact color-coded role pill inside the CNA / Pattern area, with matching person-icon color for Floor, OBS, Shower, RNA, and Extra.
  • Added compact scheduling-pattern labels under each CNA name: set weekday staff display as M / T / W / Th / F / Sa / Su combinations, 4-on / 2-off staff display as 4-2, and flexible/random staff display as On-call. Explicit available-date arrays are supported when present.
  • Changed schedule date headers to compact M, T, W, Th, F, Sa, Su abbreviations with the day number underneath, giving the calendar more usable horizontal space on phones while remaining clean on desktop.
  • Kept CNA removal, role editing, W / OFF / RO day editing, staffing targets, confidence indicators, learned next-month suggestions, 4-on/2-off flexibility, random coverage placement, and cloud saving fully functional.
  • Large / Extra Large App Text Size no longer expands role controls into a separate bulky column; the compact layout remains stable across supported display sizes.
  • No prediction mathematics, schedule authority, RO-learning rules, assignment balancing, census, 2FA, cloud permissions, or finalized assignment logic changed.
v4.16.6 · Compact Mobile Schedule Role Column
  • Fixed the DSD Schedule Maker Role column appearing oversized and taking too much horizontal space on iPhone/mobile.
  • Reduced the sticky mobile Role column from 100 px to a compact 76 px and constrained the role selector to 70 px so more schedule dates remain visible.
  • Shortened mobile-friendly role labels to Floor, OBS, Shower, RNA, and Extra while preserving the same saved role values and scheduling behavior.
  • Added a compact custom dropdown arrow and explicit overrides so Large / Extra Large App Text Size cannot stretch the schedule role control back to full-size mobile form dimensions.
  • Desktop schedule editing, learned next-month prediction, 4-on/2-off logic, random/flexible staffing, RO handling, cloud sync, and assignment logic are unchanged.
v4.16.5 · Learned Next-Month Schedule Suggestions
  • Added a DSD / Scheduler “Suggest Next Month” workflow that learns from recent saved/imported schedules instead of relying only on CNA Directory weekdays.
  • Separates staff into learned scheduling patterns: fixed weekday staff, flexible 4-on / 2-off rotations, and occasional/random monthly coverage.
  • 4-on / 2-off detection continues the six-day rotation across month boundaries, tolerates real-world schedule noise, and may move a small number of suggested workdays by ±1 day when that improves learned staffing coverage. All moves remain editable before saving.
  • Occasional/random staff are not forced into a fake weekday routine. Catered Cottage Healthcare learns their typical number of shifts per month and places suggestions on days with the greatest predicted staffing need, with prior weekday tendency used only as a light preference.
  • RO / Request Off dates are excluded from pattern learning so an approved one-date exception never becomes a learned normal OFF day.
  • Prediction rows show the learned pattern and confidence. The DSD remains the authority: every predicted W/OFF/RO cell, role, and staffing target can be changed before Save Monthly Schedule.
  • Learned staffing targets use recent same-shift schedule history by weekday, with the configured shift default as fallback. Saved predictions continue to feed the existing daily staffing/assignment suggestion engine.
  • No resident data, assignment balancing logic, cloud authorization, 2FA, viewer/staff permissions, or finalized assignment rules changed.
v4.16.4 · DSD Schedule Builder & Reliable Bug Reports
  • Added a true Create / Edit Monthly Schedule workspace for the DSD / Scheduler role and Owner/Admin. The existing cloud supervisor permission is now labeled DSD / Scheduler in the interface so the intended responsibility is clear without changing database authorization semantics.
  • DSD / Scheduler can open More Tools → Create / Edit Monthly Schedule, choose a month and shift, start from CNA Directory usual workdays, tap each date through OFF / W / RO, assign Floor / Observation / Shower / RNA / Extra roles, add or remove active CNAs, edit daily staffing targets, and save the dated schedule directly into Catered Cottage Healthcare.
  • Added Create / Edit Schedule inside the Monthly Schedule Calendar for authorized schedulers. Viewer remains view/print only; Staff / Alerts remains personal-assignment only.
  • Saved schedules become the dated staffing source used by Catered Cottage Healthcare predictions and replace the same month/shift schedule only after an authorized scheduler saves.
  • Reworked secure Suggestion / Bug delivery so the server validates the signed-in user itself, saves each valid report to protected Supabase storage first, then attempts Resend email delivery. An email-provider problem can no longer discard the report.
  • Feedback now reports when it was saved securely even if email delivery is temporarily unavailable; the report remains in the protected Catered Cottage Healthcare database.
  • No resident-identifying information is added automatically to feedback, and existing cloud RLS, 2FA, assignment distribution, census, finalization, and print security remain unchanged.
v4.16.3 · Monthly Schedule Print Blank-Page Fix
  • Fixed Monthly CNA Schedule Calendar Print / Save PDF opening a blank page, especially on iPhone/iPad Safari and mobile browsers.
  • Removed the fragile popup-window document-write print flow and now renders the selected monthly schedule into a dedicated same-page print area before opening the browser print sheet.
  • Added print-only isolation so the normal Catered Cottage Healthcare workspace, modals, navigation, and mobile controls cannot cover or hide the schedule during printing.
  • Keeps the monthly schedule in compact landscape formatting with the CNA names, daily statuses, imported bottom target, variance rows, legend, and schedule metadata intact.
  • The temporary print content and landscape page rule are removed after printing so normal assignment and History printing remain unchanged.
  • No imported schedule data, staffing prediction, assignment distribution, cloud sync, 2FA, secure history, or finalized assignment logic changed.
v4.16.2 · Cloud Sign-In 405 Fix
  • Fixed the sign-in 405 shown after a valid password on Owner/Admin accounts with authenticator-app 2FA.
  • Replaced the fragile raw GET /auth/v1/factors lookup with the supported authenticated user endpoint and reads the signed-in user's MFA factors from that response before starting the TOTP challenge.
  • Aligned password, refresh, current-password verification, and staff-signup Auth requests with Supabase client header behavior while continuing to use only the browser-safe publishable key.
  • Cloud request errors now identify the HTTP method and request path when Supabase returns an otherwise empty error response, making future login/sync failures easier to pinpoint.
  • Preserved required Owner/Admin and Supervisor 2FA, existing verified authenticators, RLS, cloud conflict protection, the v4.16.1 POST-RPC workspace save fix, and all staffing/assignment logic.
v4.16.1 · Cloud Save 405 Fix
  • Replaced direct Data REST PATCH workspace writes with an authenticated Supabase RPC that saves through POST, avoiding the browser/Data API 405 Method Not Allowed failure path.
  • Preserved optimistic concurrency protection: the server updates only when the cloud workspace timestamp still matches the version this device loaded, so a newer save from another device is not silently overwritten.
  • The new save function runs as SECURITY INVOKER, remains subject to existing workspace RLS and 2FA requirements, grants execution only to authenticated users, and denies anonymous execution.
  • Automatic retry, local pending-change protection, recovery copies, owner-only force replacement, viewer/staff read-only behavior, and normal cloud conflict handling remain intact.
  • No census, CNA assignment distribution, workload balancing, schedule import/calendar, Nursing Staff, History, finalization, print, or staff-account logic changed.
v4.16.0 · Modern Monthly CNA Schedule Calendar
  • Added a new Monthly CNA Schedule Calendar under More Tools and a View action beside each imported staff schedule.
  • Built the calendar from the actual imported monthly schedule: CNA names, Work, Off, Request Off, shift/month, and imported daily bottom totals are displayed without inventing missing schedule data.
  • Added the richer Catered Cottage Healthcare calendar design selected for this project: branded header, shift badge, professional summary cards, weekend shading, today highlight, role-aware colors, compact legend, and daily Scheduled / Imported Bottom Target / Variance rows.
  • Added a dedicated landscape Print / Save PDF view that prints the monthly schedule instead of the normal CNA assignment handoff sheet.
  • Special-role labels such as Observation, Shower, RNA, and Extra appear only when role metadata or an exact finalized assignment provides that information; Catered Cottage Healthcare does not infer those roles from a CNA name alone.
  • Schedule imports now preserve an optional role field (floor, observation, shower, rna, extra) for future DSD-generated schedules while remaining compatible with existing schema-version-1 schedule files.
  • The feature is read-only and does not alter staffing predictions, imported schedule authority, CNA Directory routines, finalized assignments, secure history/archive recovery, cloud sync, 2FA, or staff-account permissions.
v4.15.4 · Mobile Staff Invite Navigation Fix
  • Fixed the one-time Staff Invite screen on iPhone/mobile so a tall registration form scrolls inside its own full-screen layer instead of visually spilling over the app underneath.
  • Added an always-visible Back to Sign In control and an × close button at the top of the Staff Invite flow.
  • Both controls safely return to cloud sign-in, clear sensitive invite/password form values, and remove the ?join=1 URL flag so reopening/reloading does not trap the device back in the invite screen.
  • Hidden the mobile Generate / Review / Print bar while Staff Invite onboarding is active, preventing the underlying workspace controls from appearing below the registration card.
  • On mobile, Staff Invite fields now use a single-column layout for cleaner spacing and reliable scrolling with iPhone safe-area insets.
  • No staff invite security, Supabase account creation, CNA matching, alerts, PIN setup, 2FA, schedules, assignments, Nursing Staff, history/recovery, or printing logic changed.
v4.15.3 · Collapsible Nursing Staff Panel
  • Added a clear Collapse / Expand control to the main Nursing Staff panel on the Staff screen.
  • The collapsed state is remembered on the current device so mobile and desktop users can keep the nursing section compact between visits.
  • Collapsing Nursing Staff is display-only: nurse names, cart assignments, Nursing Directory data, prediction history, and finalized/printed nursing information are preserved.
  • Viewer accounts may still collapse or expand the panel while nursing-edit controls remain read-only.
  • No CNA workload balancing, nurse prediction logic, schedules, cloud sync, 2FA, secure feedback, secure history/recovery, finalization, or printing logic changed.
v4.15.2 · Secure Feedback & Cloud Password Verification
  • Fixed secure Bug Report/Feedback delivery where the server could send the email but then fail its success response with “supportLabel is not defined.”
  • Added the missing protected feedback-config response so the app can load the administrator-defined Catered Cottage Healthcare Support label and instructions without exposing the destination email.
  • Cloud password changes now require the user to enter and successfully verify the current cloud password before a new password is accepted.
  • The app also submits the current password with the Supabase password-update request; an already-open Catered Cottage Healthcare session alone is no longer sufficient for this in-app password-change workflow.
  • Current-password values are never stored in Catered Cottage Healthcare local storage or cloud workspace data and the password fields are cleared after each attempt.
  • Corrected remaining active lock/login/2FA/staff footer labels to the current app version. No staffing, schedule, rebalance, prediction, finalization, secure-history, or print logic changed.
v4.15.1 · Smart Rebalance Menu Cleanup
  • Removed three old Version History release-note blocks that were accidentally embedded inside the Smart Rebalance Preview modal.
  • Smart Rebalance Preview now contains only the before/after workload summary, impact details, and reassignment changes that belong to the rebalance workflow.
  • Version History remains available only in its proper Version History/About location.
  • No rebalance calculations, room-order/minimal-change logic, CNA workload rules, cloud sync, 2FA, secure history archive/recovery, schedules, finalization, or printing logic changed.
v4.15.0 · Secure History Archive & Recovery
  • Changed Clear History into a protected cloud-first operation. Its scope remains limited to finalized assignment history and the visible audit log; imported staff schedules are not cleared by this action.
  • Imported staff schedules now use a separate Archive action instead of direct removal. The authoritative cloud schedule entry is archived server-side before it is removed from active prediction history.
  • Added Cloud Archive & Recovery in History. Creator/Admin and Supervisor accounts can review protected archive metadata and restore missing historical records.
  • Destructive/archive/restore actions require an authorized Creator/Admin or Supervisor account, an online cloud session, and a fresh authenticator-app 2FA challenge. If the optional local Supervisor Device PIN is enabled, it is also required before the cloud verification step.
  • The browser does not supply the backup payload. The secure server function reads the authoritative cloud workspace, writes the archive first, then applies the requested change with optimistic concurrency protection so another device cannot be silently overwritten.
  • Recovery is non-destructive: it adds missing records only. Existing records and newer schedule data win; restoring an archived schedule will not replace a current schedule for the same month and shift.
  • Added a separate server-side security audit for archive, clear, and restore operations. Ordinary users cannot write archive/audit rows directly.
  • Preserved v4.14.3 shift override/night behavior, 2FA, cloud sync, CNA Directory, prediction logic, Nursing Staff, finalization, printing, imported assignment history, and bundled September schedules.
v4.14.3 · Shift Override & Night-Shift QA
  • Fixed the top Shift Override workflow so enabling manual preparation no longer silently jumps to an old/default Day selection.
  • Tapping Override now opens a focused Date + Shift picker with all three choices visible: Day (7–3), Evening (3–11), and Night (11–7).
  • The picker starts from the shift currently being shown, so overriding from Evening starts on Evening instead of unexpectedly switching to Day. Existing manual selections remain selected when reopening the picker.
  • Clarified Night date handling: the selected date is the date the 11 PM night shift starts.
  • Verified automatic boundaries: Night becomes the upcoming shift at 8 PM, current at 11 PM, remains the active shift after midnight, and Day becomes the upcoming shift at 4 AM. The NEXT SHIFT badge distinguishes preparation from the shift currently in progress.
  • Verified the bundled September 2026 Night schedule is still used as exact roster authority under manual Night override; Sep 11 resolves to 8 scheduled CNAs.
  • No resident assignment engine, CNA schedule bundle, 2FA, cloud sync, finalization, printing, or Nursing Staff logic was changed.
v4.14.2 · 2FA Database Permission Fix
  • Fixed a Supabase Row Level Security regression that could show “permission denied for table mfa_factors” immediately after authenticator-app 2FA enrollment.
  • Moved the verified-factor lookup behind a protected helper in the private database schema instead of allowing normal app sessions to read Supabase’s internal Auth factor table directly.
  • Verified Owner/Admin security behavior: an AAL1 password-only session cannot open the privileged workspace, while an AAL2 session that completed the authenticator challenge can access it normally.
  • Owner/Admin and Supervisor 2FA enforcement remains required. Viewer/Staff accounts that voluntarily enroll 2FA continue to be challenged by the app and protected server-side where applicable.
  • No CNA schedules, resident census, assignments, nursing data, directory profiles, finalized history, print logic, or bundled September schedules were changed by this backend security patch.
v4.14.1 · Mobile Startup & Interaction Fix
  • Fixed a startup JavaScript regression that could leave the app looking loaded while buttons, tabs, Settings, History, Generate, and other controls did nothing when tapped or clicked.
  • Restored the accidentally omitted core UI helpers (toast/modal controls), shift-context helpers, and CNA name datalist renderer, allowing startup and all button/tab event handlers to complete on mobile and desktop.
  • Preserved the v4.14.0 authenticator-app 2FA flow, v4.13 Directory Manager and secure feedback, bundled September schedules, prediction logic, cloud sync, finalization, printing, and mobile/desktop CNA autocomplete.
  • No CNA schedule, assignment-history, resident census, nursing, or security data was intentionally changed by this patch.
v4.14.0 · Free Authenticator 2FA & Privileged Account Protection
  • Added free authenticator-app (TOTP) two-factor authentication using Supabase Auth; no SMS provider, Twilio, or paid MFA feature is required.
  • Owner/Admin and Supervisor accounts must enroll and verify 2FA before opening the cloud workspace. Viewer and Staff / Alerts accounts may enable 2FA voluntarily; once enrolled, their future cloud sign-ins require the authenticator code.
  • Added guided QR-code enrollment, manual setup-secret fallback, 6-digit verification, login challenge, account 2FA status, and a Manage 2FA screen with support for backup authenticator factors.
  • Added protection against removing the last verified authenticator from an Owner/Admin or Supervisor account. Supabase does not provide TOTP recovery codes, so the app recommends a separate backup factor.
  • Scoped workspace RLS so AAL2 is enforced for Creator/Supervisor cloud access without unnecessarily forcing Viewer accounts into 2FA. Owner/Admin account-management endpoints now also require an AAL2 session.
  • Privileged offline access now requires a previously 2FA-verified session; otherwise internet is required to complete 2FA. The local device PIN remains a separate shared-device convenience lock.
  • Retained the v4.13 Directory Manager, secure feedback, September schedule bundles, exact-schedule authority, OFF/RO handling, short-staffing redistribution, optional Nursing Staff, assignment-photo history, cloud sync, finalization/printing, and mobile/desktop CNA autocomplete.
v4.13.0 · Directory Manager, Secure Feedback & Device Security
  • Redesigned Manage CNA Directory around instant search, shift/day/status filters, compact people rows, a focused editor, and a Weekly Schedule view so supervisors can update routines without scrolling through every CNA card.
  • Weekly Schedule edits change only the CNA Directory’s usual routine; imported dated schedules remain authoritative for exact dates and are never rewritten by routine edits.
  • Replaced the hard-coded visible feedback email with authenticated secure cloud submission. Normal users see only the Catered Cottage Healthcare Support label; the destination address stays in protected admin configuration.
  • Added Owner/Admin feedback settings for destination email, support label, subject prefix, user-facing instructions, and enable/pause control. Reporters may optionally include their signed-in email for follow-up; it is off by default.
  • Feedback technical details no longer include a local file path or Windows user folder. No resident data, room assignment details, or login email are added automatically.
  • Updated the outdated standalone-only security wording. Cloud account membership is the authorization layer; the optional device PIN is a device-level convenience lock/re-auth and does not encrypt browser storage.
  • Strengthened newly saved device PINs with salted PBKDF2-SHA256 when browser cryptography is available. Existing legacy PINs remain usable and upgrade after successful verification; a compatibility fallback remains for unsupported browsers.
  • Retained bundled September Evening/Night schedules, exact-schedule authority, OFF/RO handling, short-staffing redistribution, optional Nursing Staff, assignment-photo history, cloud sync, finalization, print behavior, and mobile/desktop CNA autocomplete.
v4.12.6 · Consolidated September Schedule Data & Regression QA
  • Bundled the verified September 2026 Evening (3–11 PM) and Night (11 PM–7 AM) CNA schedules directly into the app so a fresh or cloud-loaded workspace can recover the known schedule data without requiring the separate JSON files.
  • Bundled schedules merge non-destructively: an existing schedule for the same month and shift is preserved, so supervisor corrections or a newer import are never overwritten by the built-in copy.
  • Bundled schedule rows seed missing CNA Directory profiles and only fill missing routine hints; manually configured names, routines, preferred assignments, and notes remain untouched.
  • Verified all 30 daily CNA totals for both bundled schedules against their source transcriptions. Request Off remains a date-specific exception and is excluded from routine learning.
  • Rechecked exact-schedule roster authority, short-staffing counts, assignment-photo placement history, optional Nursing Staff with three default med carts, hidden special CNA role behavior, mobile/desktop autocomplete, backup/cloud preservation, finalization, printing, and active version labels.
  • No resident clinical information is bundled. The schedule bundle contains staff scheduling/status data only.
v4.12.5 · Desktop CNA Autocomplete QA
  • Completed a dedicated desktop autocomplete regression test covering mouse selection, Arrow Up/Down + Enter, Escape, switching between multiple CNA fields, dynamic Staff rendering, and viewport placement.
  • Capped the desktop suggestion popup at a readable 520 px instead of allowing it to stretch across a wide Staff card.
  • Refined touch-layout detection so ordinary desktop and touchscreen Windows systems with a precise primary pointer keep the desktop popup, while phones/tablets and coarse-pointer touch devices retain the inline mobile suggestion layout.
  • Desktop autocomplete continues to suggest after the first typed character and the searchable Choose from directory fallback is unchanged.
  • No CNA scheduling, OFF/RO, room balancing, nursing, cloud, finalization, or print-assignment logic was changed.
v4.12.4 · Mobile CNA Autocomplete Reliability
  • Fixed intermittent CNA name suggestions on iPhone/iPad by avoiding fragile fixed-position popup behavior while the mobile keyboard and visual viewport are moving.
  • On touch/mobile devices, matching CNA names now render directly beneath the active CNA field; desktop keeps the compact floating suggestion popup.
  • Autocomplete now responds after the first typed character, safely handles mobile composition/autocorrect events, retries after keyboard viewport changes, and delays focus-out closing to prevent tap races.
  • Added click/touch selection fallbacks, disabled browser spellcheck/autocorrect on CNA name fields, and retained the searchable Choose from directory fallback.
  • No CNA schedule, OFF/RO, room-balancing, nursing, cloud, finalization, or print-assignment logic was changed.
v4.12.3 · Version Label Consistency
  • Corrected the persistent page footer that still displayed v4.11.0 even though the active build was v4.12.2.
  • Aligned the current sidebar badge, print header, local/cloud login screens, personal PIN screen, footer, and internal APP_VERSION to v4.12.3.
  • Historical Version History entries remain unchanged so earlier releases are still documented accurately.
  • No staffing, prediction, assignment, nursing, cloud, finalization, or print-layout logic was changed.
v4.12.2 · QA & Prediction Priority Fixes
  • Fixed assignment-history schema v2 accepting a completely empty file. Nursing-only history remains valid, but a file with no CNA assignments and no nursing roles is now rejected.
  • Fixed the Nursing Directory credential option Other being normalized back to LVN/RN during import or reload.
  • Restored exact imported staff schedule authority when a same-date old-assignment import also exists. The schedule controls who is working and the roster count; old-assignment history is used only for placement evidence unless the rare special-role option is explicitly enabled.
  • Prevented special-role-only assignment-photo rows from being learned as normal room-assignment history, and prevented hidden special-role history from reducing the normal regular-CNA count.
  • Fixed the optional Nursing Staff print block so it does not print “Not used” when Nursing Staff is disabled.
  • Rechecked startup, major modal/button handlers, Nursing toggle/cart rendering, assignment-photo import review, JavaScript syntax, and duplicate element IDs. Core resident balancing, OFF/RO handling, finalization, cloud roles, and print layout remain otherwise unchanged.
v4.12.1 · CNA Special-Role Cleanup
  • Removed Float / Relief CNA from the normal Staff workflow because Catered Cottage usually assigns working CNAs to regular room groups.
  • Replaced it with a rare-use Other / Special CNA Role that is hidden by default and can be enabled from Settings only when an unusual non-room CNA role is actually needed.
  • Normal short staffing now continues to mean fewer regular CNAs sharing the current room workload; hidden special-role history no longer reduces the suggested regular CNA assignment count.
  • Retained backwards compatibility with v4.12 assignment-history JSON that used the internal float placement type, but presents it as an optional special role rather than an everyday staffing category.
  • Nursing Staff, three medication carts, assignment-photo history, exact-schedule priority, staffing-count/census-aware room patterns, workload balancing, printing, cloud sync, and finalized history remain unchanged.
v4.12.0 · Flexible Staffing Patterns & Optional Nursing Staff
  • Added an optional Nursing Staff workspace with a simple three-cart default: Med Cart 1, Med Cart 2, and Med Cart 3, plus optional Charge / Desk, Treatment Nurse, and Float / Other roles.
  • Added a separate RN/LVN Nursing Directory with usual shift, workdays, usual cart/role, credential label, active/inactive status, and editable current-shift nursing assignments. Nursing history remains separate from CNA workload balancing.
  • Extended old-assignment imports to accept schema version 2 with optional nursing roles, CNA float/relief rows, census, and total-CNA context. Schema version 1 imports remain supported.
  • Added an optional Float / Relief CNA field that is not counted as a room-assignment CNA, so a true float does not artificially reduce the resident workload target.
  • Staffing predictions can now learn different room-assignment patterns for different staffing levels and census conditions. When reliable history shows that a scheduled CNA usually floats under the same staffing configuration, the suggested regular-assignment count can adapt while keeping the float separate.
  • Placement history now gives extra weight to records with a matching room-assignment count / total staffing context, while exact schedules and date-specific OFF/RO remain the strongest roster evidence.
  • Fixed a v4.11.0 strict-mode startup regression where the new staffing suggestion planner was assigned without a declaration, which could stop clean-browser initialization.
  • Finalized shifts preserve optional nursing and float assignments for future pattern learning. Existing resident eligibility, fair workload distribution, Ordered Reassignment, observation/shower coverage, break rotation, cloud roles, and finalization protections remain unchanged.
v4.11.0 · Assignment Photo History & Smarter Placement Predictions
  • Added More / Settings / History entry points for importing old CNA assignment sheets after ChatGPT converts a photo into Catered Cottage Healthcare Assignment History JSON.
  • Imported assignment history stores date, shift, CNA, assignment number, and visible room/bed area while keeping it separate from finalized in-app History.
  • Staff prediction now gives an exact imported work schedule priority over saved routines and historical patterns; OFF and request-off remain date-specific exclusions.
  • When no exact schedule exists, prediction can use saved routines, imported schedule patterns, finalized assignments, and imported old-assignment history as progressively weaker evidence.
  • Suggested roster details now show source, usual area, High/Medium/Low confidence, and the reason for the placement suggestion before a supervisor applies it.
  • Historical room/area learning is advisory only. Census eligibility, fair resident distribution, Ordered Reassignment, care-load guidance, observation/shower coverage, breaks, finalization, printing, cloud roles, and email alerts are unchanged.

  • Choose from directory beside CNA name fields opens an alphabetical, searchable picker with 20 names per page.
  • Type-ahead suggestions remain available. Cancelling leaves the assignment name unchanged.
v4.10.3 · CNA Name Autocomplete
  • Type two or more letters to see up to five matching active CNA directory names.
  • Select by touch, mouse, or arrow keys and Enter. Empty fields never show the full directory.
  • Partial first names, last names, and accents are supported. New names can still be entered manually.
v4.10.2 · Conflict Protection & Recovery
  • Added cloud conflict review with a local backup download and confirmed cloud replacement.
  • Preserved recovery copies before cloud updates, backup imports, and recovery restores.
  • Added backup reminders and visible notices when saved data cannot be loaded.
  • Strengthened version checks and protected in-flight cloud pulls against local edits.
v4.10.0 · Staff Schedule Import & Prediction History
  • Added More → Import Schedule and a matching Settings shortcut for importing Catered Cottage Healthcare schedule JSON files created from staff-schedule photos.
  • Added a Review Import step that validates month/shift/day data, summarizes CNA/work/RO counts, automatically matches exact CNA names, and lets supervisors manually resolve possible spelling matches before saving.
  • Imported schedules now save CNA work, off, request-off, daily staffing-total, and source-pattern history. RO dates are one-date exceptions and are excluded from routine-learning calculations.

  • Staff prediction can now use imported schedule history in addition to CNA Directory routines and finalized assignment history, and predicted CNA count can use historical staffing totals while still expanding to fit all predicted names.

v4.9.0 · Assignment Guidance, Staff Name Matching & Live Update Alerts
  • Added configurable workload-guidance settings: supervisors can show or hide the Workload Advisory, show or hide lighter-load recommendations on generated assignment cards, and optionally let Generate automatically apply up to two recommended −1 lighter assignments.

  • The Staff / Alerts portal now checks for finalized assignment changes automatically while open and visibly reports when a newer revision is loaded.
  • Improved mobile printing so phone/tablet screen responsiveness no longer collapses the paper print layout; printed handoffs keep the compact paper-optimized assignment and information grids.

DSD Shift Planner

Prepare Day, Evening, or Night for any selected date
✓ NO TIME RESTRICTION
Prepare whenever DSD needs to: there is no clock-based or advance-date lock. DSD can make an assignment for today, tomorrow, several days ahead, or farther ahead, then return to that saved date/shift later to update call-offs or replacements. Automatic shift windows elsewhere in Catered Cottage Healthcare are suggestions only. For Night · 11 PM–7 AM, the patient-day date is the date the shift starts at 11 PM.
Late call-off after DSD leaves: Catered Cottage Healthcare keeps the assignment/state-paper version that DSD issued. If someone calls off later, document the change on the printed paper according to your facility/DON policy (for example, cross out the absent employee, write the replacement and actual times/assignment, and have the replacement sign). The app does not pretend that a later handwritten change was made by DSD.
